scope: Opt-in MOV CR3 WP profile and mutable diagnostic translation-session integration.

verification.independent_review: clean on final gpt-6.1-sol/high review; three findings fixed and rechecked

coverage: WP=0 and WP=1 root A-to-B switch starts with a resident hit and clears the entry before the next lookup
After each root switch the replacement root produces Walk then Hit
The original execute_mov_cr3 path rejects WP=0 before fetch
Same-value CR3 writes after user-accessible read-only PTE remap invalidate the stale hit under both WP values
After same-value invalidation, Ring0 write succeeds with WP=0, receives PFEC 0x03 with WP=1, and Ring3 write with WP=0 receives PFEC 0x07
A matching AccessKind::Fetch key at the MOV CR3 RIP is bypassed; removed PTE yields exact fetch #PF, zero retirement and unchanged CPU, and stale Fetch hit remains resident
All four page-table entries remain unchanged across successful MOV CR3 fetch and effect consumption
Unusable replacement roots commit; a precise page fault occurs only on the next probe
Every CR3 source bit 36 through 63 faults atomically with #GP(0)
Pre-fetch CR0/CR4 mismatch preserves cache and CPU; injected post-retirement CR4 mismatch with matching CR0 clears and poisons
Injected zero-retirement fault preserves cache; contradictory one-retirement fault without Cr3Write returns typed error, clears cache, poisons, and makes subsequent operations return SessionPoisoned
Existing MOV CR3 tests cover LOCK, CPL, fetch failure, prefixes, legacy input gates and exact start boundary
limits: One-entry diagnostic cache, not a production TLB
No reset, EFER/other control-register transitions, tracked A/D caching, PCID/global, JIT or SMP
